# air wish Website

> This is the landing page for air wish (@ittuann) website.

It provides information about air wish Blog, Contact information, GitHub, and others.

## Resources

- [air wish Blog](https://blog.airwish.com): The personal blog of air wish (@ittuann).
- [GitHub](https://github.com/ittuann/): The GitHub profile of air wish (@ittuann).
- [Email](mailto:ittuann@gmail.com): The email address and contact information of air wish (@ittuann).
- [Open Source Code (AGPL 3.0)](https://github.com/ittuann/ittuann.com): GitHub repository hosting the open source code for this website.
